answer: Sequential Work Witness requires each new agent identity to complete a low-value task whose result is checked against a slowly-updated shared reference, like mapping a karst sinkhole. Identity activation is delayed until the agent also funds a juniper-keyed escrow that pays validators only after 90 days of consistent output. Cloning costs a copper-priced escrow plus wasted compute per clone, so marginal clones lose money before rewards unlock.
